purpose: Teach: むかし/みち/帰ら/叩き/割っ/削り/好か/きらい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、むかしのお祖父ちゃんのお話、聞きたい?
lines.en: Sho, do you want to hear some stories about your grandfather from long ago?
lines.style: Warm, inviting opening. Gentle cadence—offering a gift, not pushing. Slight pause before the question, like she's remembering something herself. Soft and patient.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが歩いてたみち、おしえて
lines.en: Mom, which street did Grandpa used to walk on?
lines.style: Curious, eager lean-in. Sharp attention on the question. Small voice but genuinely focused. The kind of specific question that catches adults off-guard.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、今夜は帰らないって
lines.en: Sho, your dad won't be home tonight.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Not sad, not upbeat—just the simple fact. A tiny pause before saying it, like choosing the right moment. Eyes soft.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、太鼓を叩きに行ったんだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad went out to play the drums tonight.
lines.style: Small, certain statement. Matter-of-fact pride—he knows something. Not showing off, just reporting. Slight emphasis on 'drums' like it's important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、コップを割って、ガラスは危ないからね
lines.en: Sho, don't break the cup—glass is dangerous.
lines.style: Gentle but clear boundary-setting. Not alarmed, not scolding. The tone of someone who has said this before and will say it again. Warmth underneath the caution.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、鉛筆を削りに机に向かってるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's at the desk sharpening his pencils right now.
lines.style: Quiet observation, slightly puzzled. Reporting what he sees without judgment. Slow, thoughtful pace—noticing details others miss. Small trailing-off, like he's still watching.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、嫌われ者にならないでね、お友達に好かれるのよ
lines.en: Sho, don't become someone people dislike—make sure your friends like you.
lines.style: Tender but purposeful. Not lecturing—more like sharing something she knows matters. Gentle emphasis on 'like'—the heart of it. Calm, protective tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくは野菜がきらいなんだ
lines.style: Small, matter-of-fact declaration. Not whining, just stating the case as he sees it. Quiet conviction. The kind of thing he's thought about carefully.
